remarks: FROM THE MOMENT YOU ARRIVE, THE HOME'S BEAUTIFUL CURB APPEAL IS EVIDENT WITH ITS EXPANSIVE PAVED DRIVEWAY, ABUNDANT PARKING FOR FAMILY AND GUESTS, STAMPED CONCRETE WALKWAYS, AND PROFESSIONALLY DESIGNED OUTDOOR LIVING SPACES. THE LARGE YARD PROVIDES PLENTY OF ROOM FOR SUMMER BARBECUES, WINTER GATHERINGS, AND OUTDOOR GAMES. STEP INSIDE TO DISCOVER A SPACIOUS, WELL-APPOINTED INTERIOR FEATURING A THOUGHTFULLY DESIGNED FLOOR PLAN THAT FLOWS EFFORTLESSLY FROM ROOM TO ROOM. THE FORMAL LIVING ROOM PROVIDES AN ELEGANT SPACE FOR ENTERTAINING, WHILE THE SEPARATE DINING AREA IS PERFECT FOR HOLIDAY DINNERS AND SPECIAL OCCASIONS. A WARM AND INVITING FAMILY ROOM CREATES THE IDEAL GATHERING PLACE FOR EVERYDAY LIVING AND MAKING LIFELONG MEMORIES. LOCATED IN A QUIET CUL-DE-SAC SETTING JUST MINUTES FROM THE SKI SLOPES OF HOLIDAY VALLEY AND HOLIMONT, AS WELL AS THE AREA'S GOLF COURSES, ALLEGANY STATE PARK AND ACRES OF NATIONAL FORESTS. OFFERING THE PERFECT BLEND OF FUNCTIONALITY AND YEAR-ROUND RECREATION, THIS IMPRESSIVE HOME IS DESIGNED TO ACCOMMODATE LARGE FAMILIES, MULTI-GENERATIONAL LIVING, OR THOSE WHO LOVE TO ENTERTAIN. THE KITCHEN IS THE HEART OF THE HOME, FEATURING MODERN APPLIANCES, ABUNDANT CABINETRY AND GENEROUS COUNTER SPACE THAT MAKES COOKING, DINING, AND ENTERTAINING A PLEASURE. WHETHER HOSTING INTIMATE DINNERS OR LARGE CELEBRATIONS, THIS KITCHEN IS DESIGNED TO ACCOMMODATE THE EVENT. SIX GENEROUSLY SIZED BEDROOMS PROVIDE COMFORT FOR FAMILY AND GUESTS ALIKE. LARGE WINDOWS THROUGHOUT THE HOME FLOOD THE INTERIOR WITH NATURAL LIGHT. A PRIVATE 2-BEDROOM, 1-BATH SUITE WITH A SEPARATE ENTRANCE OFF THE ATTACHED 2 CAR GARAGE OFFERS INCREDIBLE FLEXIBILITY FOR AN IN-LAW APARTMENT. THE HOME IS EQUIPPED WITH AN IMPRESSIVE ARRAY OF HIGH-END MECHANICAL FEATURES INCLUDING A 22,000-WATT AUTOMATIC WHOLE-HOUSE GENERATOR, STATE-OF-THE-ART HEATING SYSTEMS, A HEAT RECOVERY VENTILATION SYSTEM (AIR EXCHANGE), AND TWO CENTRAL AIR CONDITIONING UNITS TO ENSURE YEAR-ROUND COMFORT, EFFICIENCY, AND PEACE OF MIND. ADDITIONAL UPDATES INCLUDE A NEW ROOF INSTALLED IN JUNE 2023. THE FULL BASEMENT IS READY TO BE FINISHED INTO A HOME THEATER, FITNESS CENTER, GAME ROOM, OR ENTERTAINMENT LOUNGE.
